active_work_package.title: Checkpoints validated against their schema by a stdlib test; LF pinned by .gitattributes - issue #68 (NS-036)
active_work_package.objective: Make AGENTS.md section 6 true: every committed checkpoint is validated against schemas/session-checkpoint.schema.json by a test that refuses any schema keyword it cannot enforce, with the three pre-enforcement records registered as a shrinking ratchet rather than rewritten; and pin LF for every text file so a CRLF checkout passes the byte-exact fixture checks.

stop_reason: WP-035 is done on this branch and awaits merge after fresh-context review. With it, every action an agent can execute alone is done: NS-033 (issue #52 item 3, form iii) waits on the asserted.* question posted on issue #52 on 2026-09-04; NS-024 needs a practising broker; NS-027 and NS-028 wait on packages that are not opened. Oracle authorship still requires an independent author; experiment re-run stays NOT_GRANTED.
known_divergence: The sixth instance of stale operational state (PR #56, which applied items 2 and 3 against this repository's own recorded ordering) is closed: #57 reverted it, and the fixtures are byte-identical to the sealed set at e37fa3b. A seventh opened at 2026-09-04T06:46:45Z and is closed by this commit: the human decision was recorded on issue #52, and until now this file still read resume_decision WAIT_FOR_AUTHORITY with a stop_reason naming the question that decision answers, while NS-031 - whose evidence requirement the decision had already met - remained the primary action. The interval was under four minutes because the decision record named the gap itself. That is not a fix for the underlying defect: state still reconciles by hand, and the proposal that would retire hand-maintenance remains PROPOSED on a failed instrument. WP-030 is stacked on WP-029's unmerged branch so that both can update this file without a merge conflict; if PR #58 merges with its branch deleted, GitHub retargets WP-030 to main. Until both merge, main's copy of this file still names WP-029 - that is the ordinary lag of a stacked change, not an eighth instance, because the record here says so. WP-030 merged as PR #64 after its stacked PR #60 was closed by the deletion of its base branch; the stacking rationale in DEC-028 (7) was wrong and is corrected by DEC-029 and this note - stack nothing on a branch that will be deleted. WP-031 merged as PR #65 at 28898879bef6, and the github-pages environment recorded a successful deployment of that head at 2026-09-04T15:46:34Z (deployment 6267852711). The README paragraph that said Pages was blocked and the site returned 404 was committed at 2026-09-03T12:56:32Z, five minutes after the first successful deployment (6244308440, success at 12:51:36Z), and stood until WP-032 - false when written, not merely outlived. It is replaced by pointers rather than by a fresher sentence; a fresher sentence would be the eighth instance waiting to happen. WP-032 merged as PR #67; the site's serving commit is read from the deployments API, not asserted here. WP-033 merged as PR #69 at 0b564b6. The WP-034 branch replaces the pre-dated deployment claims in LIVE_PREVIEW.md, NEXT_STEPS.md and AGENT_CONTINUITY.md by pointer and by dated correction, not by a fresher sentence. One correction to the WP-032 sentence above: the README paragraph and the runbook line were authored on 2026-09-02 while still true (cc40f0f), and merged to main five minutes after the first deployment succeeded - 'false when written' overstated it; they were false when merged and stood for a day. WP-034 merged as PR #70. From WP-035 on, a checkpoint that does not match its schema fails the test suite; the three that predate enforcement are registered by name and may only leave the registry.
